THE WORDS BEHIND THE CARDS

Common words.
Real-world Italian.

These 500 entries follow the news-frequency ranking published in Atlas Runa’s Italian word frequency list. Rankings and English meanings were retrieved on 18 November 2026.

The source groups related forms under a word: for example, forms of essere are studied together. The cards show the source’s headwords and short meanings; context can change their meaning.

Choose a top-N pool or any rank range within 1–500. Every word has an equal chance in a shuffled deck. Each appears once before the next shuffle.

Verb flashcards include present indicative conjugations, adapted from Ian Hamlin’s Wiktionary dataset under CC BY-SA 3.0. The Present tense mode practices each available person separately. Saved marks apply to the whole verb, including its forms.

Your wrong answers and words flagged for review are stored in a small first-party cookie for one year on this browser. You can remove individual words or clear the saved list. Quiz scores and current sessions reset on refresh. There are no analytics, app accounts, or backend database. A quiz draws up to 20 distinct words from your selected pool; pools smaller than 20 use every word once. Answer choices may include words from the full collection.
